description: The account's Refer & earn program: the referral link and code, clicks, signups, paying referrals, and earnings (held, available to withdraw, in review, paid, owed back from refunds). The program pays a share of every plan and credit-pack payment a referred account makes for 12 months (the current rates are in terms.ratePercent and terms.packRatePercent); the link's cookie lasts 60 days; each commission is held 60 days before it can be withdrawn. Not joined yet: says so, then join_affiliate_program. Free.
